title: Lightly Smoked Uruguayan Beef Empanadas
description: Buttery and crispy empanadas filled with smoked beef, perfect for a snack or light meal, this dish is friendly to all diets including buddhist temple friendly as it does not contain any forbidden ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine flour, cold butter, and water to make the empanada dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
In a separate pan, cook the diced onion and smoked beef until the onion is translucent.
Season the beef and onion mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place a tablespoon of the beef and onion mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten eggs for a golden glaze.
Fold the dough in half to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the remaining egg wash.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
